_comment: GENERATED by Scripts/Utilities/card_effect_tags_build.py - do not hand-edit. Source bits: 1 attack, 2 power/body, 4 trainer/energy text.

categories.label: Bonus Damage
categories.desc: Does more damage when a condition is met

categories.label: Variable Damage
categories.desc: Damage depends on Energy, counters, cards or HP

categories.label: Boost Damage
categories.desc: Makes attacks do more damage (PlusPower, Darkness Energy...)

categories.label: Power Up Next Turn
categories.desc: Sets up more damage for your NEXT turn (Swords Dance, Extra Comet Punch...)

categories.label: Flip: More Damage
categories.desc: Flip coins for extra damage on heads

categories.label: Flip: Multiply
categories.desc: Damage times the number of heads

categories.label: Risky Attack
categories.desc: If tails, the attack does nothing

categories.label: Snipe & Spread
categories.desc: Damages Benched or several of your opponent's Pokemon

categories.label: Hit Own Bench
categories.desc: Damages your own Benched Pokemon

categories.label: Self Damage
categories.desc: Damages the Pokemon using it

categories.label: Avoidable Recoil
categories.desc: Self damage you choose, or a condition switches off

categories.label: Place Counters
categories.desc: Puts damage counters straight onto Pokemon

categories.label: Move Counters
categories.desc: Moves damage counters between Pokemon

categories.label: Ignore Defences
categories.desc: Ignores Weakness, Resistance or effects

categories.label: Instant KO
categories.desc: Knocks the opponent's Pokemon Out outright (Shock-wave, Perish Song, Destiny Bond...)

categories.label: Self Knock Out
categories.desc: Knocks itself Out on purpose (Buzzap, Final Sting, Selfdestruct / Explosion)

categories.label: Counter Attack
categories.desc: Hurts the attacker when this Pokemon is hit

categories.label: Metronome
categories.desc: Picks an attack from another card to use (Metronome, Genetic Memory, Psylink...)

categories.label: Bonus Attack
categories.desc: A Trainer that gives a set attack of its own (Technical Machines, Cubes, Plates, Holon Lake)

categories.label: Conditional Attack
categories.desc: The attack only works when a condition is met

categories.label: Heal
categories.desc: Removes damage counters

categories.label: Reduce Damage
categories.desc: Takes less damage, or weakens the attacker

categories.label: Prevent Damage
categories.desc: Prevents damage done to a Pokemon (Withdraw, Agility...)

categories.label: Block Effects
categories.desc: Stops the EFFECTS of attacks or Trainers on a Pokemon (Crystal Body, Agility, 'except damage')

categories.label: Survive Knock Out
categories.desc: Stops a Knock Out and stays in play (Focus Band, Hoppip, Giovanni's Machamp...)

categories.label: HP Boost
categories.desc: Raises a Pokemon's HP

categories.label: Weakness & Resist
categories.desc: Removes, changes or ignores Weakness / Resistance as a lasting effect (Conversion, Weakness Guard, Ancient Tomb...)

categories.label: Cure Conditions
categories.desc: Removes Special Conditions (Full Heal, Lum Berry...)

categories.label: Poison
categories.desc: Can Poison a Pokemon

categories.label: Burn
categories.desc: Can Burn a Pokemon

categories.label: Sleep
categories.desc: Can put a Pokemon to Sleep

categories.label: Paralyze
categories.desc: Can Paralyze a Pokemon

categories.label: Confuse
categories.desc: Can Confuse a Pokemon

categories.label: Self Condition
categories.desc: The user falls Asleep, Confused, etc.

categories.label: Condition Immunity
categories.desc: Can't be Poisoned / Asleep / affected by Special Conditions (Snorlax, Roselia, Zangoose...)

categories.label: Energy Gain
categories.desc: Attaches extra Energy

categories.label: Energy Removal
categories.desc: Discards or removes your opponent's Energy

categories.label: Energy Discard
categories.desc: Discards or returns your own attached Energy

categories.label: Energy Move
categories.desc: Moves Energy between Pokemon

categories.label: Energy Supply
categories.desc: Provides extra Energy, or Energy of other types

categories.label: Cost Change
categories.desc: Changes attack or retreat costs

categories.label: Draw Cards
categories.desc: Draws cards

categories.label: Search Deck
categories.desc: Searches a deck for cards

categories.label: Fill the Bench
categories.desc: Puts Pokemon straight onto the Bench

categories.label: Recover Discards
categories.desc: Gets cards back from the discard pile

categories.label: Discard Cards
categories.desc: Discards cards from your own hand

categories.label: Hand Disruption
categories.desc: Messes with your opponent's hand

categories.label: Mill Deck
categories.desc: Discards cards from the top of a deck

categories.label: Deck Disruption
categories.desc: Shuffles or reorders a deck, or slips cards into it

categories.label: Look at Cards
categories.desc: Looks at or rearranges hidden cards

categories.label: Prize Cards
categories.desc: Takes extra Prizes or uses Prize cards

categories.label: Return to Hand/Deck
categories.desc: Returns Pokemon in play to the hand or deck

categories.label: Trainer Tricks
categories.desc: Counts, finds, discards or borrows Trainer cards (Lass, Milotic δ...)

categories.label: Switch
categories.desc: Switches your Active Pokemon

categories.label: Pull Opponent
categories.desc: Switches your opponent's Active Pokemon

categories.label: Easy Retreat
categories.desc: Lowers or removes retreat costs

categories.label: Block Retreat
categories.desc: Stops or slows retreating

categories.label: Block Attacks
categories.desc: Stops the Defending Pokemon attacking

categories.label: Cooldown
categories.desc: The user can't attack next turn

categories.label: Fast Evolution
categories.desc: Evolves early or straight from the deck

categories.label: Devolve
categories.desc: Removes Evolution cards from play

categories.label: Block Evolution
categories.desc: Stops Pokemon evolving

categories.label: Change Form
categories.desc: Swaps a Pokemon for another form or card

categories.label: Type Change
categories.desc: Changes a Pokemon's own type, yours or your opponent's (Venomoth Shift, 'is both Fire and Fighting type')

categories.label: Bench Size
categories.desc: Changes how many Pokemon a Bench can hold

categories.label: Plays as Pokemon
categories.desc: A Trainer played as if it were a Pokemon

categories.label: Block Trainers
categories.desc: Stops Trainer cards being played

categories.label: Block Abilities
categories.desc: Shuts off Pokemon Powers / Poke-Bodies

categories.label: Block Energy
categories.desc: Stops or weakens your opponent's Energy

categories.label: Markers
categories.desc: Places marker tokens on Pokemon

categories.label: On Knock Out
categories.desc: Something happens when a Pokemon is Knocked Out (Final Beam, Lanturn, Time Shard...)

categories.label: Prize Count
categories.desc: Changes with how many Prize cards are left (comeback attacks, Pokemon Star last-Prize attacks)

categories.label: Drawback
categories.desc: A downside its owner has to live with

categories.label: Coin Flip
categories.desc: Flips one or more coins

categories.label: Species
categories.desc: Needs or boosts named Pokemon (Nidoking, Omanyte, Latias...)

categories.label: Named Trainers
categories.desc: Gym Leaders, Team Aqua / Magma, named Stadiums and Trainers

categories.label: Type
categories.desc: Works with your Pokemon of a type (Metal, Fire, Darkness...)

categories.label: Dark & Light
categories.desc: Works with Dark, Light or Shining Pokemon

categories.label: React Energy
categories.desc: React Energy cards and the Pokemon that use them

categories.label: Holon
categories.desc: Holon Energy and Holon Trainers

categories.label: Delta Species
categories.desc: Works with Pokemon that have δ on the card

categories.label: Unown
categories.desc: Every Unown card, and cards that use them

categories.label: Special Energy
categories.desc: Uses, needs, discards or blocks Special Energy (not React / Holon)

categories.label: Condition Synergy
categories.desc: Only works, or works harder, when a Pokemon is Asleep / Poisoned / Burned / Confused (Dream Eater, Frenzy...)

categories.label: Tool Synergy
categories.desc: Finds, attaches, moves, recovers or powers up with Pokemon Tools / Technical Machines

categories.label: Stadium Synergy
categories.desc: Finds or plays Stadiums, or does more while a Stadium is in play

categories.label: Supporters
categories.desc: Finds, recovers, counts or borrows Supporter cards

categories.label: Own Damage
categories.desc: Changes with the damage counters on itself (Rage, Flail, Take Down...) - pairs with damage movers

categories.label: Pokemon-ex
categories.desc: Works with, or only on non-, your Pokemon-ex (Protective Orb, Swellow, Holon Energy...)

categories.label: Stage
categories.desc: Works with your Basic / Evolved / Stage 2 Pokemon (Boost Energy, 'as long as @ is Evolved')

categories.label: Vs Pokemon-ex
categories.desc: Changes when the opponent's Pokemon is a Pokemon-ex

categories.label: Vs Stage
categories.desc: Changes for the opponent's Baby, Basic, Stage 1, Stage 2 or Evolved Pokemon

categories.label: Vs Dark & Light
categories.desc: Changes when the opponent's Pokemon is Dark, Light or Shining

categories.label: Anti-Tool
categories.desc: Discards or blocks the opponent's Tools / attached Trainers, or punishes having one

categories.label: Anti-Stadium
categories.desc: Discards Stadiums or stops them being played

categories.label: Vs Damaged
categories.desc: Stronger against a Pokemon that already has damage counters - pairs with snipers

categories.label: Vs Type
categories.desc: Changes when the opponent's Pokemon is a certain type
